title: feat(spec): an action's answer fields gain a table format, drawn from its columns
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99t9cZ56QWVVy4s6njKh4d8)_

Fixes #34391

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — the console does not draw `table` yet (`columns` is `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]`, liveness `planned`); teaching it in `skills/**` before the renderer lands would advertise a format that draws nothing, so the skill line belongs with the renderer half

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作结果弹窗与预读面板的字段格式加了「表格」`table`,字段可写 `columns` 列清单；四种写错的组合在解析阶段直接报错。
- 为什么改：您在 #33187 选了 A(记录 6915677641),加人、导入 CSV 这类逐行结果今天只能显示成一大块 JSON。
- 风险与回滚：只加不删，以前能解析的动作仍原样解析；控制台的表格渲染还没做(#33187),在它落地前写了 `table` 的字段只显示标题。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`(新拒收与 `resultDialog` 上的渲染约定)、`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`(两行类型改为从契约派生)、`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/action-answer-table-format.test.ts`,预期 47 例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地(契约复审由席位转 review 席位)。

## What changes

- `ACTION_ANSWER_FIELD_FORMATS` gains `table`. The shared field row (`actionAnswerFieldRow`, used by both `resultDialog.fields` and `preflight.fields`) gains `columns`: an array of `{ path, label?, format? }`, where `path` is read in ONE element of the array. A column reuses the row's alias map (`key`/`field`/`name` to `path`, `title` to `label`, `display`/`render` to `format`).
- Four new refusals, all on the new value or the new key:
  1. `columns` beside any `format` other than `table`, or on a field with no `format` (the dialog-level default is never `table`): `custom` at `...fields.N.columns`.
  2. `format: 'table'` without `columns`, or with `columns: []`: `custom` at `...fields.N.columns`. Refused, not defaulted to the element's keys (seat ruling R2; Prime Directive 12).
  3. `table` as a cell `format`: `invalid_value` at `...columns.M.format`, with its own message.
  4. `resultDialog.format: 'table'`: `invalid_value` at `resultDialog.format`, with its own message (seat ruling R3).
- The dialog-level set and the cell set are DERIVED from the field set with `z.enum(...).exclude(['table'])`; there is no second hand-written list (R3, R4).
- The renderer contract for `table` is stated on `resultDialog` beside the other five formats (R5). Where R5 and the console's existing behaviour for the sibling formats differ, this PR matches the sibling, as R5 allows: a MISSING value is skipped like any other field's, and a NON-ARRAY value draws as `json`, as `code-list` does (the console's `ResultField`).
- `columns` carries the `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` marker, and its liveness rows (`preflight.fields.columns` and its three children) are `planned` until the console reader lands; the `resultDialog` row's note says the same.
- `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts`: the two hand-written `format` unions on `ResultDialogSpec` / `ResultDialogFieldSpec` now derive from the contract (`SpecResultDialog['format']`, `SpecResultDialogField['format']`), the way their label members already do. Without it the widening reds `@object-ui/components`' build, because `action-button.tsx` and `action-icon.tsx` forward `schema.resultDialog` uncast into the runner's type (measured: TS2322 at both sites). Type only; no renderer change.
- Regenerated with the repo's generators: `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx`, the strictness-ledger counts, liveness state counts. `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gains the 24 sites the build named for the new row refinement (a value-dependent rule, so it has no projectable arm). `check:authorable-surface` and `check:api-surface` are green with no file change (no export was added).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@object-ui/core` patch.

## Renderer contract the console half must honour

From the `resultDialog` doc comment (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, the `table` bullet):

- value must be an array; each element is one row and each entry of the field's `columns` one cell, in `columns` order;
- the header of a column is its `label`, falling back to its `path`;
- a cell reads the column's dot `path` in the element; a missing value (the path resolves to `undefined`) draws an empty cell;
- a present value draws in the column's `format` (omitted: `text`) when it fits that format the way a field's value must (`qrcode`, `secret` and `text` take a string, `code-list` an array of strings); any value that does not fit, whatever the column's format (an object or an array under the omitted `text`, a number under `secret`), draws as compact JSON text, which is also how `json` draws in a cell;
- an element that is not an object has no paths to read: its row draws the element itself as compact JSON text in the first cell and leaves the other cells empty;
- `[]` draws the header row over an empty-state line;
- a field value that is missing is skipped like any other field's, and one that is not an array draws as `json`, as `code-list` does.

## Tests

- New: `packages/spec/src/ui/action-answer-table-format.test.ts` (47 cases). Every case runs at both surfaces. CONTROL: each of the five pre-existing formats parses on a field and as the dialog default, a bare `path` row parses, and the row still refuses an unknown key and an unknown format and answers its aliases. Widening: a `table` row parses and is kept as written; each non-`table` format parses as a cell; a column answers all six aliases. Refusals 1 to 4 each assert `code` + path + the first clause of the message.
- Forced edit: `packages/spec/src/ui/action-preflight.test.ts`, the case "`fields` is `resultDialog.fields`' row: its aliases and its format set" used `format: 'table'` as its unknown-format probe. `table` is now a member, so the probe is `chart`; the assertion (`invalid_value` at `preflight.fields.0.format`) is unchanged.
- Forced edit: `packages/spec/scripts/strictness-ledger.test.ts` pins the number of `strictObject` sites in `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`. The new column row adds one closed object, so the pinned count moves from 12 to 13; nothing else in the test changes.
- Forced edit: `packages/spec/scripts/strictness-ledger.test.ts`, the case "does not count a z.object( that appears inside a comment" pins the strictObject site count of `ui/action.zod.ts`; the new column row adds one site, 12 to 13 (comment line added beside the earlier moves).

## Acceptance notes

- No existing input is refused: every new refusal needs `table` or `columns`, neither of which parsed before.
- Until the console half lands, a `table` field draws its label and no value (`ResultField` has no `table` branch). This is why `columns` is marked planned.
- The `ui/` edit is outside the original file surface; the seat accepted it (claim amendment 6932171004). It is the minimum that keeps the required UI checks green and touches no renderer.

## Verification

Head and gate readings are in the report comment on the card (`os-dev-report`), taken after the last commit.

<details><summary>Ablations (each refusal removed, its pins red, restored to HEAD)</summary>

Run with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`, against `action-answer-table-format.test.ts`:

- A1, refusal 1 (`if (row.columns !== undefined)` made false): 12 failed (the five formats and the no-format case, at both surfaces).
- A2, refusal 2 (`columns` missing or empty check made false): 4 failed.
- A3, refusal 3 (the cell format swapped for the field set): 2 failed.
- A4, refusal 4 (the dialog-level format swapped for the field set): 1 failed.

Each leg restored: blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 847 files, 27116 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0 (test typecheck included).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`: all 14 artifacts current; `check:liveness` exit 0.
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0 (red before the `ActionRunner.ts` edit).
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the file list: NOT governed.

</details>
